references.qualification: 118m is the instrument-limited deepest valid sample, not a detected flow bottom or proof of flow below it. Source full-column language is restricted here to the valid13–118m domain; no0–150.3m physical layer,105m thickness or extrapolation to the130m ADCP mounting depth. The early regime oscillated and was not the same northwestward current. The paper challenges a permanent Guyana Current at22m and below; retain episodic identity and regional shelf scope instead of imposing a universal annual current. NBC rings, southeastward Guiana undercurrent and deeper circulation are not assigned this depth. M3 fouling and lost M1 meter are separate instruments, not M2 depth evidence.
